verification.validation: Focused non-root Compose recovery guidance and incoming preflight regressions, generated-version and immutable executor metadata checks, Node/frontend builds and package content scans validate this release preparation. Separate live evidence covers administrator CLI recovery of owned stopped projects, a Compose fixture and repair of an existing published App package with retained data and key plus HTTP/HTTPS login; it does not claim deployment of this SDK release or full lifecycle acceptance. Executor sources and canonical tasks are unchanged; the immutable executor/v0.49.5 inventory is reused. No publication is implied.

changes: Add actionable package hook log guidance for same-name stale Compose project registrations, including ownership checks and repair steps that preserve volumes, data and images.
Keep the SDK under its package account; administrator-side automated recovery is provided by the CLI.
Reuse the immutable executor/v0.49.5 release and its six digests.
